programme.title: El capo

programme.title: El capo

programme.title: El capo

programme.title: El capo

programme.title: El capo

programme.title: El capo

programme.title: El capo

programme.title: El capo

programme.title: El capo
programme.desc: El "relojero" delata al Yupi, es avisado y se mueve a un billar. Incendian la celda de Isabel y Julieta, salen con bien. Pedro Pablo piensa cambiar de escondite por un procesión con los Santos.

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.desc: Men don't have a monopoly on murder, but it's still extraordinary when women kill. Though female killers are as deadly as males, they choose less violent methods.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Years after a murder has been committed, investigators use advanced DNA analysis to shed new light on crimes that have gone unpunished for far too long.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims – And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder – These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: About Face

programme.title: ER: Caught On Camera

programme.title: Body Bizarre
programme.desc: 'S5/E3 - My Face Is Killing Me'. A Romanian boy's face grows too fast, slowly choking him to death, and doctors try a possible treatment. Plus, a child was born with an extra arm on his back.

programme.title: Body Bizarre
programme.desc: 'S5/E4 - Limbless Little Girl'. An English girl whose limbs had to be amputated when she was born is fitted for prosthetics. A Polish man is the world's first recipient of a donor hand.

programme.title: Mr Vampire

programme.title: A World Without Thieves
programme.desc: While con man Bo and femme fatale Li swindle their way across China, Li suddenly decides to leave Bo. However, their encounter with Fu Gen changes their fate forever.

programme.title: Disciples Of The 36th Chamber

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid

programme.title: The Tigers

programme.title: Ultimate Mission

programme.title: The Lady Hermit

programme.title: Clean My Name, Mr Coroner

programme.title: Ip Man

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
